headline: Crowley CLAPS BACK 🥊💥 DSA DREAMS 💭❌ in WI WIPEOUT 🍕🏆

Crowley's late SURGE 📈😤 was more SHOCKING ⚡ than Bernie Sanders 😎👴 skipping the race like he ghosted 🍆💨 a Tinder date! Hong's police defund 💰🚔 and Thanksgiving diss 🦃💩 comments came back to HAUNT 👻 her faster than TikTok trends 📱💀, and even AOC 🦖🌹 and Bernie 🥪👴 stayed HOME 🏠 instead of dropping their usual INSURGENT endorsements 🔥📣! Crowley posted on X 🐦💬 saying it's time to GET TO WORK 🛠️💼 focusing on AFFORDABILITY 💰🏠, SCHOOLS 📚🏫, JOBS 💼💵 and OPPORTUNITY 🌟 everywhere in the state - basically the centrist playbook 📖 that beats DSA socialism every time! 🍕🧀
